name: Trif
source:
An all-ages game by doujin circle triangle. She was very very beautiful, like she was in a picture, cut off from the world. So beautiful and pure, as if she would break if merely touched. This was the first night when I fell in love at first sight.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/08/01/august-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
